WITH closing AS (
  SELECT item_code, SUM(signed_units) AS net_units
  FROM unit_moves
  GROUP BY item_code
), ranked AS (
  SELECT c.item_code, c.net_units, n.rate_cents, n.source_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.item_code ORDER BY n.floor_units DESC) AS notice_rank
  FROM closing AS c JOIN rate_notice AS n ON n.item_code = c.item_code AND n.floor_units <= c.net_units
), adjustments AS (
  SELECT r.item_code, r.net_units, r.net_units * r.rate_cents - s.booked_cents AS adjustment_cents, r.source_id
  FROM ranked AS r JOIN settlement_balance AS s ON s.item_code = r.item_code
  WHERE r.notice_rank = 1
)
SELECT 'item_code,net_units,adjustment_cents,source_id' || char(10) || COALESCE(group_concat(line, ''), '') AS csv_content
FROM (
  SELECT item_code || ',' || net_units || ',' || adjustment_cents || ',' || source_id || char(10) AS line
  FROM adjustments
  WHERE adjustment_cents <> 0
  ORDER BY item_code COLLATE BINARY
)
